Welcome to the world of Pokemon.They are our friends, our allies.
They live beside us, work,play and battle with us.
You are now entering the world of Pokemon. What was your name again?

costumes.text: The Professors Lab of PokemonMystery!
House owned by guy with red Hair.
There is nothing on the TV. It is a blankscreen.
Just a bunch of dusty old books.
Honey, Professor Oak is waiting for you in his lab. You don't want to keephim waiting.
You know, he may have a surprise for you. Anyways, Watch yourself.
Ah, yes, your here. I was wondering if you would be so kind as to look afterone of my pokemon.
They don't like each other very much I'm afraid and I beleive that by takingone out they will quit.
Please, Just scroll over each one andchoose. No take backs.
Good Choice! Now then, can you visitMr. Pokemon For me? He says he hasSomething for me. Thanks.
Here is a Potion for your trip.+1 Potion!
Hey, you can't go into the grass! It is not safe. Although, no one would miss a weakling like you...
Hey, you finally got a pokemon! Wannabattle? Not like you could win or anything...
Whatever, I didn't try to hard anyways.Smell you later, Loser!
Route 29Home of Rattata, Pidgey, and Sentret
Route 46Home of Jigglypuff, Geodude, and Spearow
Red challenged you to a battle!
Opponent got hurt by its poison!
Opponent got hurt by its burn!
Opponent is paralyzed! It  can'tmove!
You are paralyzed! It can'tmove!
You got hurt by your burn!
You got hurt by your poison!
Let me heal your Pokemon for you.Just one sec.
All Done! Here are your Pokemon.
You hurry back to the nearest           Pokemon center, protecting      your weak pokemon from                 further harm.
